title: 第9章 抱一抱总可以第10章 你是狗吧轻点
slug: 领证爽约我转嫁你哥哭什么
content_zh:
第9章抱一抱总可以？第二天一大早，唐凝醒来，发现自己整个身体恨不得挂在纪瑾修身上。
像个八爪鱼一样，手和脚都压着他，场面一度尴尬。
唐凝懵了。
她睡姿怎么这么豪迈？
好在，纪瑾修还没醒，唐凝小心翼翼把手脚都收回去，生怕惊醒他，她紧抿着唇大气不敢出。
想起昨晚回来睡觉前，纪瑾修打趣：“夫人做好跟我睡的准备没有？”
唐凝当即红了脸，吐槽他：“你怎么满脑子黄料？”
纪瑾修调侃：“不怪我，谁让我活了二十八年，终于娶老婆了？”
“不让睡，抱一抱总可以吧？”
夫妻之间抱一抱，本来没什么问题。
可他们以前不对付，突然成了夫妻，关系十分尴尬。
唐凝想了想，身体往他身边挪了挪，提醒：“只能抱，不许想别的。”
谁能想到，睡醒后发现，她才像需要被警告的那个。
唐凝收回手脚，本以为动作够轻了，坐起身想趁着没被发现快点逃离，却感觉身后一道目光正注视她。
她脊背一僵，缓缓回头，顿时尴尬的脚趾扣地。
纪瑾修手心支着脑袋，深邃的眼眸正凝视着她，唇角微微扬起弧度，似笑非笑看着她。
“想抱我，说一声就是，我们都是夫妻了。”
“不不不……”唐凝脸颊一热，急忙摆手，“你误会了。”
她说完这句话，顾不上看纪瑾修的反应，逃似的跑去了卫生间洗漱。
看着她仓皇逃离的背影，纪瑾修唇角的弧度愈发上扬，不由溢出声笑。

没出息的，不禁逗。
洗漱完，唐凝接到传媒公司的电话通知过去开会。
她换上一条素白色及膝长裙下楼，看到纪瑾修坐在餐桌前，走了过去。
纪瑾修在看手机，侧脸线条精致流畅，五官轮廓立体，帅得惊为天人，一身深色西装衬得他矜贵冷峻，冷冰冰的姿态，仿佛拒人千里。
而他面前摆放着一份西式早餐，却没动，似乎在等她一起。
在他对面位置，还放着一份西式早餐，一杯牛奶。
空气里弥漫着淡淡的清香，由远及近。
下一秒，唐凝来到餐桌对面。
纪瑾修抬眼看她，瞳孔映入她的曼妙的身影。
她一身素白及膝无袖长裙，露出洁白纤细的手臂。
裙身是收腰的设计，勾勒出盈盈一握的细腰，修长的脖颈之上，那张明媚艳丽的脸，看着温婉大气，又不失娇媚。
content_en:
Chapter 9 Is it okay to have a hug? Early the next morning, Tang Ning woke up and found that her whole body wanted to hang on Ji Jinxiu's body.
Like an octopus, his hands and feet were pressing him down, and the scene was once awkward.
Tang Ning was stunned.
Why is she sleeping so boldly?
Fortunately, Ji Jinxiu hadn't woken up yet, so Tang Ning carefully retracted her hands and feet. For fear of waking him up, she pursed her lips tightly and dared not speak out.
Thinking of Ji Jinxiu joking before coming back to bed last night: "Madam, are you ready to sleep with me?"
Tang Ning immediately blushed and complained to him: "Why are you so full of pornographic stuff?"
Ji Jinxiu joked: "Don't blame me, who allowed me to live for twenty-eight years and finally marry a wife?"
"If you don't let me sleep, it's okay to give me a hug, right?"
There is nothing wrong with a hug between husband and wife.
But they didn't deal with each other before, and suddenly they became husband and wife, and their relationship was very awkward.
Tang Ning thought for a while, then moved her body towards him and reminded: "You can only hug him, don't think about anything else."
Who would have thought that when she woke up, she would be the one who needed to be warned.
Tang Ning retracted her hands and feet, thinking that the action was light enough. She sat up and wanted to escape quickly without being discovered, but she felt a gaze from behind her looking at her.
Her back stiffened, she turned back slowly, and her toes dug into the ground in embarrassment.
Ji Jinxiu rested his head on his palms, staring at her with his deep eyes, slightly raising the corners of his lips, looking at her with a half-smile.
"If you want to hug me, just say it and we are both husband and wife."
"No, no, no..." Tang Ning's cheeks heated up and she waved her hands hastily, "You misunderstood."
After she said this, she didn't care about Ji Jinxiu's reaction and ran to the bathroom to wash up as if she was running away.
Looking at her hastily escaping back, Ji Jinxiu's lips curved upward, and he couldn't help but laugh.
You can't help but laugh at the unpromising ones.
After washing up, Tang Ning received a call from the media company informing her to go over for a meeting.
She put on a plain white knee-length skirt and went downstairs. She saw Ji Jinxiu sitting at the dining table and walked over.
Ji Jinxiu was looking at his mobile phone. His side profile was exquisite and smooth, and his facial features were three-dimensional. He was stunningly handsome. His dark suit made him look dignified and cold, and his cold attitude seemed to be alienating him from thousands of miles away.
There was a Western breakfast in front of him, but he didn't move, as if he was waiting for her to join him.
Opposite him, there was a Western breakfast and a glass of milk.
The air is filled with a faint fragrance, from far to near.
The next second, Tang Ning came to the opposite side of the dining table.
Ji Jinxiu raised his eyes to look at her, her graceful figure reflected in his pupils.
She was wearing a plain white knee-length sleeveless dress, revealing her white and slender arms.
The skirt has a waist-cinching design, which outlines a slender waist. Above the slender neck, the bright and gorgeous face looks gentle and elegant, yet still charming.
